name: Chilecito
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in La Rioja province. Torrontés Riojano is the most planted grape at 28%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec and Bonarda at around 10% each.
